title: Qualification Basis for the Keyturn Host Payout Schedules
content:
A host moves onto the highest-ranked Keyturn Host Payout Account schedule whose qualifying monthly earnings, qualifying settled trips and qualifying tenure they all meet, and onto the entry schedule where they meet none of them.

## The three qualifying figures

**The qualifying monthly earnings** are the trip earnings credited to the account in the month up to that day, with nothing netted into them and nothing set aside. That figure is rounded half to even to two decimal places before any floor is tested against it.

**The qualifying settled trips** are the trip earnings credited to the account in the month up to that day, counted one to a trip.

**The qualifying tenure** is the whole calendar days from the day the payout account was opened up to that day, and the qualifying settled trips are counted from the trip earnings the account itself carries rather than from the trips the host has run over the whole life of their membership.

## The floors, tested from the top down

The schedule is settled by testing the three qualifying figures against each schedule's floors from the highest-ranked schedule downwards, and the first schedule whose earnings floor, trip floor and tenure floor are all met is the schedule the host moves onto.

| Rank, highest first | Schedule | Earnings floor | Trip floor | Tenure floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Keyturn Reserve-Backed Settlement Schedule | 20000.00 USD | 150 trips | 365 calendar days |
| 2 | Keyturn Fleet Settlement Schedule | 8000.00 USD | 100 trips | 180 calendar days |
| 3 | Keyturn Instant Payout Schedule | 1200.00 USD | 25 trips | 90 calendar days |
| 4 | Keyturn Express Payout Schedule | 500.00 USD | 10 trips | 60 calendar days |
| 5 | Keyturn Weekly Batch Payout Schedule | No earnings floor is tested | 3 trips | 30 calendar days |
| 6 | Keyturn Standard Payout Schedule | The schedule taken where no higher schedule's floors are all met | | |

A floor is met where the qualifying figure stands at it or above it, so a figure exactly at a floor satisfies it.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical account whose trip earnings credited in the month up to that day come to 1400.00 USD across 26 such entries, and which was opened 120 calendar days before that day.

- The qualifying monthly earnings are 1400.00 USD, the qualifying settled trips 26 and the qualifying tenure 120 calendar days.
- The first row is not met, the earnings standing below 20000.00 USD. The second is not met either, the earnings standing below 8000.00 USD.
- The third row asks 1200.00 USD, 25 trips and 90 calendar days; all three are met, so the account moves onto the Keyturn Instant Payout Schedule and no lower row is reached.

Had the same account been opened only 80 calendar days before that day, the third row would fail on tenure and the fourth would be reached, where 1200.00 USD stands above 500.00 USD, 26 stands above 10 and 80 stands above 60; the account would move onto the Keyturn Express Payout Schedule.
